description: How do I get the transcript of this video? Platform-aware extraction for any video source — YouTube, local files, or other platforms. Use when (1) need to transcribe a video for analysis, (2) user provides a video URL, (3) building a knowledge base from video content. Provides multiple methods with guided fallback chain (captions > Whisper > web services). Does NOT trigger for: watching videos, video editing, or non-transcript tasks.
